Scope: hits = `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md`, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md`, `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` + cited = `scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs`, `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs`, `AGENTS.md`, `.github/workflows/half-state-patrol.yml`, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/state-machine.md`

### ① Derived judgments

1. Assign at `pr_create` = the claim's Account — CORRECT. `os-dev.md:38` 「PR 派认领 `Account:`(`pr_create` 带)」 and `os-dev.md:63` 「`pr_create`(draft,含 labels 与 assignees)」 replace 「⛔ 不带 `assignees`」/「⛔ 无 assignees」; `execution-duties.md:69` 「PR 派认领账号」; `SKILL.md:199` 「`pr_create` 派不请」. The relay already accepts it: `ops.mjs:2091` lists `assignees` as optional on `pr_create`, and the second-leg mechanism is `ops.mjs:58-70`.
2. Hand-over re-assigns in the same stroke — CORRECT. `execution-duties.md:69` 「交棒同笔改」; `os-dev.md:38` 「交棒归席位」 (the dev's side: the hand-over is the seat's, not the dev's). The card hand-over step `execution-duties.md:92` (② assignee 同笔换人) is unchanged and now covered by L69's PR clause.
3. Reviewer request to the seat's own account still forbidden — CORRECT. `SKILL.md:198` keeps 「⛔ 永不请席位自身账号」, dropping only the 派 half; the author-is-approver `assign` fallback stays.
4. Tier S/H landing rules unchanged — CORRECT. `SKILL.md:197` (③ 请审 = 席位交棒) and `SKILL.md:203` (Tier S = `.claude/**`, 余皆 Tier H) are untouched; the diff touches only L198-199.
5. "dev never writes the CARD assignee" preserved — CORRECT. `os-dev.md:36-38` 「卡 assignee 归 PM … 恒不写卡的 assignee」, `execution-duties.md:69` 「卡 assignee 归 PM,dev 恒不写」, `dispatch-runbook.md:140` now says 「不写卡 assignee」 (narrowed from a bare 「不写 assignee」 that would have contradicted the ruling). `SKILL.md:29/104-106`, `state-machine.md:41` card-assignee rules unchanged and consistent.
6. No in-surface leftover — CORRECT. `git grep` of `.claude/**` at head for `assignee|不派|派席位|不带 \`assignees\`|无 assignees|交棒才|席位自身` finds no line saying a PR carries no assignee; every remaining `assignee` hit is a card/seat-post rule (e.g. `SKILL.md:29,92-110`, `seat-post-protocol.md:11`, `platform-readings.md:170-171,236` which are read-channel caveats, not the rule). `dispatch-runbook.md:138` (线程 ⛔ 不做 harness 开 PR 后指派/请审) forbids the harness's post-open assign, which the relay-carried `assignees` does not use — not a contradiction.
7. Out-of-surface restatements still carry the old rule, as the PR declares: `AGENTS.md:403-404` ("nor the PR's: `pr_create` carries none; the seat sets it at hand-over") and `ops.mjs:103-105`, `ops.mjs:2093-2094` ("a dev's create carries no `assignees`"). Not edited here — carrier items, correctly left out of a Tier S diff.
8. H76 report-only — CORRECT. `check-half-states.mjs` H76 predicate (the new block after `h72OffTableMailboxLines`) returns a string or null and writes nothing; the sweep wiring only does `findings.push([pr, 'H76', unowned])` over `seenPrs` (populated from `listOpenPullRequests` at L23790, the REST `/pulls?state=open` listing at L21563, which carries `assignees`/`assignee`); band `H76: 'state'` (H1's band, L19617). `half-state-patrol.yml:84`: "Findings never fail anything. A completed sweep exits 0 whether it found 0 or 40"; `lint.yml:1275` runs only `--self-test`. No gate reads it.
9. Mailbox exemption — CORRECT: `MAILBOX_LABEL = 'pm:mailbox'` (`mailbox-open.mjs:153`) imported lazily the same way H72 does (L23811 vs L23853); unread label fires `UNJUDGED_MARKER` (L18073) rather than clean; an assigned PR is clean regardless.
10. Battery meaningful — CORRECT: 12 cases, pin 11 (house "pin just under the count", as L25259-25375 neighbours), covering firing, draft/ready parity, both assignee fields, mailbox vs unlabelled twin, closed/missing rows, three unread-label UNJUDGED legs, not-loud, band + `familyRegistryCoverage().emitted` (L20038-20055 regex matches the push), lazy-import wiring, roster floor. Probe: `✓ check-half-states self-test: 5252 cases pass … H76 unowned open PR 12/11`, exit 0.
11. Ceilings/byte caps hold — CORRECT: line counts main→head os-dev 405→405, SKILL.md 319→319, dispatch-runbook 245→245, execution-duties 188→188 (zero headroom each, ratchet run ✓ exit 0); changed lines measure 117/105/116/116/120/119 bytes against `MAX_LINE_BYTES = 120` inclusive (`check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs:2714,2935`). Governed-prose and skill-id-lint runs exit 0.
12. Head delta: `git patch-id` of `561d532c4..7c76c755` equals the three-dot diff at head (`66332495cd…`), so the merge commit added nothing.

### ② Semver level

None — no package touched (paths are `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**`); `skip-changeset` label present, Check Changeset check-run success. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` re-derived as correct: no `packages/spec/**`, no published schema, no metadata protocol surface in the file list.

### ③ Boundary flags

- PR author login: `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay-opened, `relay-pr.out` read-back "Assignees as the pull lists them: os-elon-musk"); no off-relay write.
- Relay comments `ops.mjs:103-105`, `2093-2094` restate the old rule — answered: outside surface while PR #30782 holds `ops.mjs`; carrier = seat's relay-docs follow-up. Accepted.
- `AGENTS.md:403-404` restates the old rule — answered: Tier H, outside this card; its own pointer resolves to `os-dev.md` rule 2, which now reads the new text. Carrier = seat files the card. Accepted.
- Governed-review plan counts an assigned approver as covered — answered: `SKILL.md:93` 「批准账号永不跑席位或作其关联用户」, so a claim's Account can never be a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` login; the dev assignee cannot mask a request. Accepted; #30292 is out of scope.
- H76 has no "unassigned with a note" exemption — accepted: report-only, the ruling's first arm (assign the lane seat's account) silences it.
- Backfill not run in this PR — correct per ruling and dispatch pin 3; `backfill.json` is in the seat folder; the seat runs it through the relay after landing.
- The os-dev report on #29828 referenced by the PR body ("the same 58 families are re-run on that head; their record is in the os-dev report") is not yet posted (card has 3 comments, PR has 1). The 7c76c755 reconcile (58/58/0) and `pnpm lint :: exit 0` are in the seat folder; the head delta is patch-identical, and my probe re-ran the four pm families at head. Not blocking; the seat should see the report land before ACCEPT.
- Ruling applied to itself: PR assignee `os-elon-musk`, `requested_reviewers` empty, `draft: true`, `auto_merge: null`.
- Head check-runs (48): 31 completed success/skipped, 0 failure, 15 still `in_progress` (Lint ×8, Type Check ×4, Test Core 1/8 and 2/8, Live half-state sweep) at the read for this record. Landing waits for all green per `SKILL.md` ②.

### ④ Design judgment

- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` (L38, L63): the two dev-side lines encode arms 1 and 2 of the ruling in the dev's voice (what `pr_create` carries; the hand-over is not the dev's), keep the card-assignee prohibition, and stay inside the write budget line. Holds.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (L198-199): the minimal edit — 「派/请」 → 「请」, 「不请不派」 → 「派不请」 — keeps the reviewer-request prohibition and the author-is-approver fallback intact, and reads with ③ (L197) unchanged. Holds.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md` (L69): the rule body — assign the claim's account, re-assign at hand-over in the same stroke — sits in the 认领 section beside L68's `Account:` derivation and L92's card hand-over step, so the PR re-assign is the same stroke as the claim change. Holds.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md` (L140): narrowing 「不写 assignee」 to 「不写卡 assignee」 is required, since a thread's `pr_create` now writes the PR's. Holds.
- `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`: predicate, band, sweep wiring and battery follow the H72/H75 pattern (lazy import, UNJUDGED on unread input, not loud, no write, no exit effect); the row names WHO/HOW and the mailbox out-of-scope. Holds.

No must-fix. No should-fix.
